#CategorySeverityElementDescription
1 Semantics CRITICAL Price sub-label "قدم فارًا" (Предложить беглеца / Submit a fugitive) — EN original: "Propose your cost". "قدم" = submit/present, "فارًا" = fleeing/escaping (masculine accusative participle). Together: "Present [someone] fleeing / Offer a fugitive". This is a dangerous and offensive phrase. Expected: "اقترح سعرك". Element: sub-label below R price, center section.
2 Semantics CRITICAL ETA chip (map) "٦-٢ رجل" (6-2 мужчина / 6-2 man) — EN original: "2–6 min". "رجل" = man (singular noun). Should be "دقيقة" (minute). "Minutes" has been incorrectly rendered as "man". Element: green ETA chip on map, top section.
3 Semantics CRITICAL Destination ETA label "نادي جرس الغلاية ~ ٢٤ رجال" (Клуб Гиря ~ 24 мужчин / Kettlebell Club ~ 24 men) — "رجال" = men (plural of رجل). Should be "دقيقة/دقائق" (minute/minutes). Same root error as ETA chip: "min" (minutes) translated as "رجال" (men). Element: destination field, top address bar.
4 RTL CRITICAL Back button Back button "←" is positioned on the LEFT side. In RTL (Arabic) layout, the back button must be on the RIGHT side with arrow pointing right "→". Current layout is not mirrored. Element: back navigation button, map area left side.
5 Semantics ERROR Economy vehicle tier label "علم الاقتصاد" (Наука экономика / The science of economics) — EN: "Economic". "علم الاقتصاد" is the academic discipline of Economics (university subject). For a vehicle tier the expected term is "اقتصادي" (economic/budget) or "عادي" (standard). Element: vehicle category label, ride options section.
6 Semantics ERROR Waypoint label "قم" (Встань / Get up / Arise) — EN: "Entryway". "قم" is the imperative form of the verb "to stand up / to rise". This appears to be a mistranslation or wrong string key. A waypoint entry label should not mean "stand up". Expected: "مدخل" (entryway/entrance). Element: waypoint label, top address bar right side.
7 Consist. WARNING Auto-confirm price numeral "السيارة تقبل عرض R" — uses Eastern Arabic numeral "١٣" in the auto-confirm label, while all visible prices in the price cards use Western Arabic "13" (R, ~R, ~R). Mixed numeral systems on single screen. Element: auto-confirm toggle label, bottom section.
